summary.zh: 匹配 NIH 院所、评审组与资助机会
summary.en: Maps a research idea to NIH institutes and funding calls

description.zh: 围绕 NIH 的资助问题，把研究想法对应到合适的研究所、评审组和资助公告，并匹配适用的资助机制，最后给出申请策略。适合在准备申请前判断该投哪个方向、哪类项目。仅覆盖 NIH，需要联网查询公开的资助数据。
description.en: Maps a research idea to the right NIH institutes, study sections and funding announcements, matches suitable mechanisms and drafts a strategy. Useful when preparing an application and deciding where to send it. Covers NIH only.
